== Description ==

[[Joe Olson]] (left) playing [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (right), with [[Logan Pietig]] watching and spectators [[Sam Tashima]] (back left, red pullover) and [[Mark Billings]] (back left, black sunset T-shirt) standing behind at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; remaining faces unlabeled.
